newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Western Met makes 1-for-2 rights issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Western Met makes 1-for-2 rights issue.

text.p: Western Metals Ltd said on Tuesday it would make a one-for-two renounceable rights issue at 85 cents a share to raise A$66.4 million before expenses.
Western Metals said the funds raised would be used to develop its Blendevale and Kapok lead and zinc mines in Western Australia and to develop its new export facility at Derby in Western Australia.
"The equity raised from this rights issue will enable Western Metals to be in a strong financial position to progress development of existing projects expeditiously," it said.

"Raising modest levels of debt to complete these projects and finance other potential projects will be facilitated by the enhanced equity base and will therefore enable the company to maintain conservative gearing ratios."
Western Metals said the issue had been fully underwritten by stock brokers Merrill Lynch and BZW as joint underwriters and books would close to determine entitlements on February 7.
The issue price compared with the market level of A$1.03 at 0400 GMT (3 p.m.), down two cents on Monday's close.
